t: A tiny Linux camera board with a small AI chip for about 10 dollars.
steps: Buy the board from the Luckfox store or Waveshare. US resellers often charge more.
Get a microSD card, a USB-C cable and a USB serial adapter for first boot.
Download the Buildroot image from the Luckfox wiki and flash it to the card.
Log in over ADB or SSH across the USB cable as the wiki shows.
Set the pin modes with the luckfox-config tool. Then blink an LED from the command line.
Attach the camera and try the RKNN example on the wiki next.
meta: Open Board. From $12.74. A few stores.
